```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)


```

```{r}
df <- read_csv("~/Desktop/stat/player_market_value.csv")

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    date_unix = ymd(date_unix),
    year = year(date_unix)
  )

# 3. Keep only 2021–2023
df_2123 <- df %>%
  filter(year >= 2021 & year <= 2023)

# 4. Count distinct years for each player
year_counts <- df_2123 %>%
  group_by(player_id) %>%
  summarise(n_years = n_distinct(year), .groups = "drop")

# 5. Keep players who appear in at least 2 years
valid_players <- year_counts %>%
  filter(n_years >= 2) %>%
  pull(player_id)

df_2123_valid <- df_2123 %>%
  filter(player_id %in% valid_players)

# 6. For each player-year, keep only the latest record
df_final <- df_2123_valid %>%
  arrange(player_id, year, date_unix) %>%          # sort oldest → newest
  group_by(player_id, year) %>%                     # group by player & year
  slice_tail(n = 1) %>%                             # keep *latest* date per year
  ungroup()

```

```{r}
write_csv(df_final, "player_market_value_cleaned.csv")

df_final

```

```{r}
mv_clean <- read_csv("~/Desktop/stat/player_market_value_cleaned.csv")
profile  <- read_csv("~/Desktop/stat/player_profiles.csv")

merged <- mv_clean %>%
  left_join(profile, by = "player_id") %>%
  relocate(
    current_club_name,
    .before = 1
  )
```

```{r}
wide <- merged %>%
  select(player_id, current_club_name, year, value,height,citizenship,is_eu,main_position,foot) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = year,
    values_from = value,
    names_prefix = "value_"
  )
```

```{r}
team <- read_csv("~/Desktop/stat/team_competitions_seasons.csv")

team_ranks_wide <- team %>%
  filter(season_id %in% 2021:2023) %>%              # keep only 2021–2023
  select(team_name, season_id, season_rank) %>%     # only what we need
  distinct(team_name, season_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%  # just in case
  mutate(season_id = paste0("rank_", season_id)) %>%    # rank_2021, rank_2022, ...
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = season_id,
    values_from = season_rank
  )
```

```{r}
players_with_ranks <- wide %>%
  left_join(
    team_ranks_wide,
    by = c("current_club_name" = "team_name")
  )
```

```{r}
players_champion <- players_with_ranks %>%
  filter(if_any(starts_with("rank_"), ~ .x == 1))
```

```{r}
perf <- read_csv("~/Desktop/stat/player_performances.csv")

```

```{r}

perf_yrs <- perf %>%
  mutate(
    year_start = case_when(
      str_detect(season_name, "^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}$") ~
        2000 + as.numeric(str_sub(season_name, 1, 2)),
      str_detect(season_name, "^[0-9]{4}$") ~ as.numeric(season_name),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(year_start %in% 2021:2023)
```

```{r}
perf_summary <- perf_yrs %>%
  group_by(player_id, year_start) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      c(
        nb_in_group,
        nb_on_pitch,
        goals,
        assists,
        own_goals,
        subed_in,
        subed_out,
        yellow_cards,
        second_yellow_cards,
        direct_red_cards,
        penalty_goals,
        minutes_played,
        goals_conceded,
        clean_sheets
      ),
      ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    ),
    perf = goals + assists,   # now uses the *summed* goals & assists
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

```{r}
players_champion_perf <- players_champion %>%
  left_join(perf_summary, by = "player_id") %>%
  relocate(year_start, goals, assists, perf, .after = player_id)
```

```{r}
players_champion_perf_wide <- players_champion_perf %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(player_id, current_club_name, height,
        citizenship,
        is_eu,
        main_position,
        foot,starts_with("value_"), starts_with("rank_")),
    names_from = year_start,
    values_from = c(goals, assists, nb_in_group,
        nb_on_pitch,
        goals,
        assists,
        
        
        own_goals,
        subed_in,
        subed_out,
        yellow_cards,
        second_yellow_cards,
        direct_red_cards,
        penalty_goals,
        minutes_played,
        goals_conceded,
        clean_sheets
       ),
    names_glue = "{.value}_{year_start}"   # e.g., goals_2021, assists_2022
  )
```

```{r}
players_champion_perf_wide <- players_champion_perf_wide %>%
  select(-starts_with("goals_conceded_"))

players_champion_perf_wide <- players_champion_perf_wide %>%
  select(-assists_NA)%>%
  select(-goals_NA)

```



```{r}
write_csv(
  players_champion_perf_wide,
  "~/Desktop/stat/players_champion_perf_wide_2.csv"
)
```
